title: Implement sqlite-vec vector search + Embedder seam + hybrid ranking
description:
**Files:** `src/store/embed.rs` (new: `Embedder` trait — model id, dim 384, batch embed; `StubEmbedder` kept solely as an internal unit-test seam), `src/store/vector.rs` (new: vec0 k-NN + cosine scores), `src/store/query.rs` (hybrid merge via reciprocal-rank fusion, deterministic), `tests/steps/store_steps.rs`.

**Specs turned green:** `08_vector_search.feature` — remove its @wip.

**Acceptance:** per Ryan's decision (BOTSPY-bb60bb closed): `08_vector_search.feature` exercises the REAL all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embedder — the deterministic stub is never the shipped embedder and never drives vector/semantic search specs (internal unit tests only). The embedder is a store-open concern (no embedder configured → semantic queries return a clean empty result, text queries unaffected); meta model id set on first embed, a mismatched model refused with a clean error; hybrid merge of FTS + k-NN results via reciprocal-rank fusion, composable with filters, one ranked result type for both paths; engine invisible.
